scenes.en: Haumea Studio. Build open.mp and SA-MP maps, right inside San Andreas.
Search thousands of objects, and drop them straight into the world, right where you click.
Particle effects play live in the editor, just like they do in game.
Scrub through the day, and see how your map looks at sunset, or at night.
Design textdraws right over the game view.
Then press F5. Haumea compiles your map and starts an open.mp test server, with the streamer, ready to join.
Haumea Studio. Free, and open source.
